In the event of any accident involving indemnity to more than one person any limitation by the
terms of this Policy and/or of any Endorsement thereon of the amount of any indemnity shall
apply to the aggregate amount of indemnity to all persons indemnified and such indemnity shall
apply in priority to the insured.

apply to the aggregate amount of indemnity to all persons indemnified and such indemnity shall
apply in priority to the insured.

independent of any other cause shall within six calendar months of such injury result in:
Nature of Injury
Scale of Compensation

100%

limb and sight of one eye
100%
(iii) Loss of one limb or sight of one eye
50%

than named above
100%

liquor or drugs.
c.

representatives whose receipt shall be the full discharge in respect of the injury to the
insured.
